backbone.role: neural-physical scorer for feature (1) optical/sensor consistency
backbone.loaders: train_arm_a_ft.py (frozen v1_1, READ-ONLY): load_C, load_E, SESSIONS, preprocessing

arm_scoring.boundary_policy: an offset leaving [0, rows_total) is ABSENT for that row and never imputed (matches published_protocol_eval)
arm_scoring.noise_policy: per PRESENTED frame: a torch generator seeded with a deterministic mix of (eval_seed, session, present_row); the same noise is reused across the correct and all wrong-offset conditions for that presented frame. This keys noise to frame IDENTITY (not stream position) so that reordered/spliced sequences remain comparable to genuine ones. It is a valid reproducible instance of the published t=150/K=1/eps-MSE protocol; realised values differ from published_protocol_eval (which draws in row order), the protocol does not.
arm_scoring.score: eps-MSE = mean((model(q_sample(C,t,noise), E, t) - noise)^2), bf16 autocast, model never denoises

f1_consistency.declared: (1) optical/sensor consistency of the frame under its declared emission E_t
f1_consistency.per_frame: margin_t = mean_over_available_offsets(wrong_mse) - correct_mse  (equivalently: consistency:=-correct_mse, wrong_arm_mean:=-mean(wrong_mse), margin=consistency-wrong_arm_mean). This is the published delta_wrong_mean per row.

f2_temporal.declared: (2) frame-to-frame temporal coherence of that consistency along the chain
f2_temporal.per_adjacent: d_t = -abs(margin_t - margin_{t-1}) over consecutive PRESENTED rows
f2_temporal.pooled: median_t(d_t); a length-1 sequence yields 0.0 by declaration
f2_temporal.rationale: temporal coherence of feature (1) is the frame-to-frame stability of the consistency signal; a temporally-incoherent (spliced) forgery breaks it

f3_bank_xcorr.declared: (3) cross-correlation of the frame's neural-physical statistics against a held-out bank of KNOWN-REAL captures
f3_bank_xcorr.bank_fit: over BANK-split real rows (disjoint from calibration and test): mu_B = mean(margin), sigma_B = std(margin, ddof=1, floored at 1e-9)
f3_bank_xcorr.per_frame: s_t = exp(-0.5 * ((margin_t - mu_B)/sigma_B)^2)  in (0,1], Gaussian-kernel match of the frame's consistency statistic to the known-real distribution
f3_bank_xcorr.rationale: for a scalar neural-physical statistic, cross-correlation against a known-real bank is operationally a distributional match; the bank-standardised Gaussian kernel is a bounded, monotone similarity. LIMITATION: distributional match on a low-dimensional statistic, not a full spatial feature-map cross-correlation.

aggregation.primary_sequence_score: f1 pooled = median_t(margin_t). This is the frozen headline 'one number per sequence' named verbatim in the prereg; ROC, Youden-J threshold, FPR and FNR are computed on THIS.

auxiliary_combined.note: declared auxiliary combination of the full 3-feature vector; reported, NOT the headline. Standardised by BANK-split statistics only (test never touched).
auxiliary_combined.standardise: z_k = (pooled_k - bank_mean_k) / bank_std_k, bank stats over BANK subsequences

holdout.tail_policy: a trailing remainder of length >= subsequence_len/2 becomes its own shorter subsequence; a shorter tail is merged into the previous subsequence
holdout.split_assignment: deterministic round-robin of subsequences (in fixed session,block,offset order) across [bank, calib, test]; declared and reproduced by holdout.assign_splits with split_seed
holdout.disjointness: bank/calib/test row sets MUST be pairwise disjoint; verified loudly (raises) before any scoring

metrics.threshold: Youden-J (max tpr-fpr) on the CALIBRATION split (real vs the same attack class), disjoint from test

security_diagnostic_labelling.rule: classes 3 (replay/splice) and 4 (white-box) are generator-free and are reported as SECURITY DIAGNOSTICS / attack-success distributions, NEVER as a realness ROC and NEVER pooled into one realness number
security_diagnostic_labelling.reason: the auditor was explicit that calling the pooled discrimination of generator-free attacks 'realness' would be misleading; classes 1 and 2 (photorealistic conditional generators) are not built
